## Quality checklist (required)

- [ ] **Fictional**: every person, employer and school in an example is invented, with the fictional-person note at the top.
- [ ] **No private data**: emails use example.com, phone numbers use the 555-010x range, no real resumes.
- [ ] **Plausible numbers**: every number fits the level and role.
- [ ] **Formula**: each bullet has an action, what was built, a number or scope, and an outcome.
- [ ] **License**: any adapted text or template is from MIT/Apache/CC0 and credited.
- [ ] **Style**: plain words, sentence case headings, no em dashes.
- [ ] I checked that internal links resolve.
